name: TC Metro & Suburban Mah Jongg Club
description: Twin Cities club with 100+ members playing at community centers, a grocery store cafe area and breweries (Roseville, New Brighton, south Minneapolis, St. Paul). Own Meetup page says: "American Style: bring a current card" and "Bring the current NMJL card and Mah Jongg set if you have one." Also plays riichi. RSVP requested.
address: Hiawatha School Recreation Center, 4305 E 42nd Street, Minneapolis, MN
schedule: Plays up to 7 days a week; e.g. Tuesdays 10:00 AM at Hiawatha School Recreation Center, Tuesdays 2:00 PM at BlackStack Brewing (St. Paul), Mondays 9:00 AM at New Brighton Community Center, Sundays 12:00 PM at Lunds & Byerlys Roseville
